title: Finite-Precision Algebraic Quantum Field Theory: Quantum Parcels, Locality, Modular Structure and Factors
summary: We develop Interval Algebraic Quantum Field Theory (IAQFT), a finite-precision operational formulation of algebraic quantum field theory (AQFT). Physical experiments provide only finitely many observations at finite resolution and therefore determine regions of compatible states rather than uniquely specified point states. IAQFT represents this information by quantum parcels---non-empty convex weak$^*$ open regions of state space---with observational parcels determined by finitely many finite-precision expectation constraints.
